issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) and the example usage in the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java) specify a no-argument method messageOnRide(): String and show calls to r.messageOnRide() with no parameters. The solution, however, defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Rideable.java) and implements messageOnRide(int speed) in Pig (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Pig.java) and Seal (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Seal.java). This parameter mismatch (no-arg vs. one int parameter) creates a clear contradiction between the exercise specification/template and the provided solution code and will confuse students about the required API and expected return string.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable API consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix (preserve original UML and template): change the solution to declare Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to implement public String messageOnRide() that returns the string format described in the problem (e.g. "Riding on Pig Doodle"). Update any solution call sites accordingly. Alternatively, if the exercise should require a speed parameter, update the problem statement, UML diagram, and the template Main example to document and use messageOnRide(int speed).
